title: Cardiovascular Technologists and Technicians
description: Conduct tests on pulmonary or cardiovascular systems of patients for diagnostic, therapeutic, or research purposes. May conduct or assist in electrocardiograms, cardiac catheterizations, pulmonary functions, lung capacity, and similar tests.

tasks.text: Conduct electrocardiogram (EKG), phonocardiogram, echocardiogram, stress testing, or other cardiovascular tests to record patients' cardiac activity, using specialized electronic test equipment, recording devices, or laboratory instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Diagnostic instruments applied to patients by hand

dwas.name: Test patient heart or lung functioning.
Operate diagnostic or therapeutic medical instruments or equipment.

tasks.text: Explain testing procedures to patients to obtain cooperation and reduce anxiety.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Results delivery needs empathy and clinical judgment

dwas.name: Explain medical procedures or test results to patients or family members.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Monitor patients' blood pressure and heart rate using electrocardiogram (EKG) equipment during diagnostic or therapeutic procedures to notify the physician if something appears wrong.
tasks.rationale: decision support — In-procedure patient monitoring is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Monitor patient conditions during treatments, procedures, or activities.

tasks.text: Obtain and record patient identification, medical history, or test results.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Collect medical information from patients, family members, or other medical professionals.
Record patient medical histories.

tasks.text: Monitor patients' comfort and safety during tests, alerting physicians to abnormalities or changes in patient responses.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Clinical handoff carries accountability and nuance

dwas.name: Monitor patient conditions during treatments, procedures, or activities.
Inform medical professionals regarding patient conditions and care.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Prepare and position patients for testing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically positioning patients for exams

dwas.name: Position patients for treatment or examination.

tasks.text: Attach electrodes to the patients' chests, arms, and legs, connect electrodes to leads from the electrocardiogram (EKG) machine, and operate the EKG machine to obtain a reading.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Diagnostic instruments applied to patients by hand

dwas.name: Operate diagnostic or therapeutic medical instruments or equipment.
Prepare patients physically for medical procedures.

tasks.text: Adjust equipment and controls according to physicians' orders or established protocol.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on medical equipment adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust settings or positions of medical equipment.

tasks.text: Check, test, and maintain cardiology equipment, making minor repairs when necessary, to ensure proper operation.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Hands-on examination of medical instruments

dwas.name: Examine medical instruments or equipment to ensure proper operation.
Maintain medical equipment or instruments.
Repair medical facility equipment.

tasks.text: Supervise or train other cardiology technologists or students.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

dwas.name: Train medical providers.
Supervise patient care personnel.

tasks.text: Compare measurements of heart wall thickness and chamber sizes to standard norms to identify abnormalities.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.text: Maintain a proper sterile field during surgical procedures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Maintaining sterile field requires hands

dwas.name: Maintain sterile operative fields.

tasks.text: Observe ultrasound display screen and listen to signals to record vascular information, such as blood pressure, limb volume changes, oxygen saturation, or cerebral circulation.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Display monitoring partly automatable; clinical judgment human

dwas.name: Monitor video displays of medical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Assist physicians in the diagnosis and treatment of cardiac or peripheral vascular treatments, such as implanting pacemakers or assisting with balloon angioplasties to treat blood vessel blockages.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sterile hands-on surgical assistance

dwas.name: Assist healthcare practitioners during surgery.

tasks.text: Assess cardiac physiology and calculate valve areas from blood flow velocity measurements.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Routine medical calculations; human checks inputs

dwas.name: Calculate numerical data for medical activities.

tasks.text: Operate diagnostic imaging equipment to produce contrast enhanced radiographs of heart and cardiovascular system.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Imaging equipment operated with patient positioning

dwas.name: Operate diagnostic imaging equipment.

tasks.text: Observe gauges, recorder, and video screens of data analysis system during imaging of cardiovascular system.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Display monitoring partly automatable; clinical judgment human

dwas.name: Monitor video displays of medical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Inject contrast medium into patients' blood vessels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Administering imaging substances is hands-on clinical procedure

dwas.name: Administer medical substances for imaging or other procedures.

tasks.text: Transcribe, type, and distribute reports of diagnostic procedures for interpretation by physician.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Summarize diagnostic and care activities into reports

dwas.name: Prepare reports summarizing patient diagnostic or care activities.
Perform clerical work in medical settings.

tasks.text: Set up 24-hour Holter and event monitors, scan and interpret tapes, and report results to physicians.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Clinical handoff carries accountability and nuance

dwas.name: Prepare medical supplies or equipment for use.
Operate diagnostic or therapeutic medical instruments or equipment.
Inform medical professionals regarding patient conditions and care.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Perform general administrative tasks, such as scheduling appointments or ordering supplies or equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Medical supply ordering via systems; human approves

dwas.name: Schedule patient procedures or appointments.
Perform clerical work in medical settings.
Order medical supplies or equipment.
